en.headline: DSE appeal results add one more super top scorer from Yuen Long school
en.dek: A student from Heung Yee Kuk Yuen Long District Secondary School secured seven 5** grades after a successful biology review, lifting the year’s total top scorers to 25 and super top scorers to 12.
body: The Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority released the results of HKDSE appeals today, adding one more “super top scorer” and bringing the total number of top scorers to a record 25.

Sun Yuen-ching of Heung Yee Kuk Yuen Long District Secondary School obtained 5** in Chinese, English, Mathematics, three elective subjects and Mathematics Extended Part Module 2, together with an “Attained” grade in Citizenship and Social Development, after a successful appeal in biology. She has been admitted to the University of Hong Kong’s Faculty of Medicine under the School Nominations Direct Admission Scheme.

The Authority said the number of candidates achieving six 5** grades (plus Attained in Citizenship and Social Development) rose by one to 25, while those also securing 5** in both Mathematics Compulsory and Extended Parts increased by one to 12.

zh.headline: 文憑試覆核結果新增一名超級狀元 來自元朗鄉中
zh.dek: 新界鄉議局元朗區中學孫菀青成功覆核生物科後共獲七科5**，今屆狀元增至25人、超級狀元增至12人，已獲港大醫學院錄取。
body: 香港考試及評核局今日公布文憑試成績覆核結果，新增一名「超級狀元」，令今屆狀元人數增至25人，屬歷屆最多。
新界鄉議局元朗區中學的孫菀青成功覆核生物科成績後，在中英數及三個選修科目、數學延伸部分單元二均取得5**，同時於公民與社會發展科取得「達標」。她已透過「學校推薦直接錄取計劃」獲香港大學醫學院錄取，將修讀內外全科醫學士及醫學研究碩士雙學位課程。
考評局表示，覆核後合共六科取得5**級（包括公民科達標）的考生人數增加一名至25人；當中同時於數學必修及延伸兩部分均取得5**級的考生人數亦增加一名至12人。
